eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 55 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

code:
SELECT p.Name
FROM Production.Product AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
  WHERE sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
);
caption: SELECT 1 is a convention — EXISTS never looks at WHAT columns come back, only IF any row does.

eyebrow: NOT EXISTS — the safe NOT IN
code:
SELECT p.Name
FROM Production.Product AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
  WHERE sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
);
caption: No value-by-value comparison — so no NULL trap like Lesson 53's NOT IN.

subtitle: Naming a subquery so you can reuse it.
